Upstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00406
⌈If the BswMDevErrorDetect switch is enabled, the routine shall check if the
BSW Mode Manager is initialized.
In case of an error, the BswM shall ignore the
mode request and report the error to the Default Error Tracer with the error code
BSWM_E_UNINIT.⌋
[SWS_BswM_00206]
Upstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00323
⌈If the BswMDevErrorDetect switch is enabled, the parameter CurrentClientState
shall be checked for being in the allowed range. In case of an error the BswM shall
ignore the mode request and report the error, to the Default Error Tracer with the value
BSWM_E_REQ_MODE_OUT_OF_RANGE.⌋
